{{Top|leg}}
The '''ribcage''' was the curved wall of [[Rib/Legends|ribs]] that surrounded and protected the [[Breast/Legends|chest]] area in some [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. In that species, the ribcage consisted of twelve pairs of ribs. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was put into his [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|suit of armor]], his ribcage was temporarily removed so the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] could install the organ implants that were needed to ensure his survival.
